title: Kovee KCP operation registry — K0 frozen (K1 bundles) + K2 slices 1-2 (governed_work_binding_v1 binding + formation halves)

sources.design: DESIGN.md §11.6 (feature bundles) and §11.6.1 (normative authority matrix), with §9.2 as the AuthorizationDependencySet category key
sources.amendment: design/2026-07-25-amendment-governance-owner.md §A5 (wire-name resolution) and §A1 (governance owner retargeting in descriptive text)
sources.revision: k2-3: the developer_assistant_v1 worker row `model_complete` added for the K2 model broker — the §11.6.1 worker-operations family's `model` operation — extracted from DESIGN.md §16.1-§16.3 and byom DESIGN.md §13.1-§13.3 (act_intent_prepare/position/finalize then execution_permit_consume); the k2-2 rows are unchanged. k2-2: the governed_work_binding_v1 formation rows (endeavor_promotion_prepare/start/show/cancel/reconcile, byom_episode_binding_show) added for K2 slice 2, extracted from byom DESIGN.md §16.3/§16.6 item 3 and the Kovee-owned descriptors endeavor-formation.json / byom-episode-binding.json; the k2-1 rows are unchanged (spec/registry-README.md)

a5_note: No A5 wire-name rename applies to the three K1 bundles. K2 slice 1 extracted the greenfield-binding half of governed_work_binding_v1 (personal_governed_work_enable/show/disable → governance_enable/show/disable); K2 slice 2 extracts the formation half (mission_promotion_prepare/start/show/cancel/reconcile → endeavor_promotion_*, sage_turn_binding_show → byom_episode_binding_show). The bundle's remaining operations (collaboration_context_bundle_prepare/show, workspace_provider_manifest_show/list, workspace_allocation_binding_show) are NOT in this registry, so the bundle is still incomplete and is not advertised by hello/protocol_info (§11.6: bundles are atomic). The byom_subordinate reservation saga (byom §16.6 item 4) has no KCP row at all: byom's kernel initiates it at resource_allocate, so Kovee executes it as a host transaction, never as a client-callable operation. See spec/registry-README.md.
